clue.text: Something wicked and frivolous helps dispel the gloom

definitions.note: a phrase describing what the soft glow from a taper does

parts.note: a candle has a wick, so it is jokingly something wicked
light means frivolous, not serious, as in light reading

explanation.surface: A naughty, frivolous diversion cheers somebody up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wicked' reads as evil but means fitted with a wick.
explanation.definitionFit: A flame's glow is a source of illumination that pushes back darkness.

clue.text: One should drive clean away from it

definitions.text: One should drive clean away from it

parts.words: One should drive clean away from it
parts.note: a motorist drives off from this place with a sparkling vehicle, not a getaway from a crime

explanation.surface: Advice to make a clean getaway from a scene.
explanation.definitionFit: A cleaning station for cars is where a motorist arrives dirty and leaves with a gleaming vehicle.

clue.text: Part of church left for contemplation

definitions.note: describes the belly button, the object people proverbially gaze at when lost in thought

parts.note: the nave is the main body of a church

explanation.surface: A section of a church set aside for quiet meditation.
explanation.walkthrough: Navel-gazing is self-absorbed reflection, so the belly button is the thing 'for contemplation'.
explanation.definitionFit: The belly button is proverbially stared at during idle introspection, as in navel-gazing.

clue.text: A close run, maybe, for kleptomaniac

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters of these words could be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: A tight race seems a likely match for a compulsive thief.
explanation.definitionFit: A kleptomaniac compulsively steals, and larcenous means given to theft.

clue.text: Put down face up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: dial is slang for a face, and also the face of a clock

explanation.surface: An instruction to lay something on the table face upwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns DIAL around in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Laid is the past tense of lay, to set something down.

clue.text: New range of French bombs

indicators.note: new signals that the letters of range are made into a fresh word

parts.note: des is French for of the (plural)

explanation.surface: A new line of French munitions goes on sale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' makes GRENA from RANGE; DES is French.
explanation.definitionFit: Grenades are small explosive devices thrown by hand.

clue.text: Used by athletes, it helps to make a record

definitions.meaning: a running circuit at a stadium

definitions.text: it helps to make a record
definitions.meaning: a single song or band is one of the parts making up an album

explanation.definitionFit: A running circuit is used in athletics, and one song is a section of an album or disc.

clue.text: Walks like a duck and dawdles around

indicators.note: around suggests the letters of dawdles are moved about

explanation.surface: A slow walker strolls like a duck while loitering.
explanation.definitionFit: To waddle is to walk with short swaying steps, as ducks do.

clue.text: Striking claim for a working-model

definitions.meaning: a model at work might say they are sitting for an artist

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition splits the word as I'M POSING, what a model at work would say.
explanation.definitionFit: Something grand and impressive is striking; a model on the job is sitting for the camera.

clue.text: Location for a bank-holiday?

parts.note: bank refers to the edge of a river, so a holiday on a bank would be by the water

explanation.definitionFit: A holiday spent on a riverbank would be by the water's edge.

clue.text: Like Mars, unlike Venus?

parts.note: Mars the god of war carries weapons, while the famous statue Venus de Milo has no arms

explanation.walkthrough: The Venus de Milo statue has lost its arms; Mars is the god of war.
explanation.definitionFit: The war god bears weapons, whereas the famous statue of the goddess of love lacks arms.

clue.text: Joined forces?

parts.note: the phrase reads as a verb but describes armies that have united in a coalition

explanation.definitionFit: Countries fighting on the same side form a coalition of military powers.

clue.text: Finance two aeronautical operations

parts.note: to bank is to tilt a plane in a turn
a roll is a full rotation of a plane about its long axis

explanation.surface: Pay for a pair of flying manoeuvres.
explanation.definitionFit: To bankroll is to fund or back financially.

clue.text: Animals find fruit around river

indicators.note: around shows the fruit word encircling the river

parts.note: hips are the fruit of the rose
the Po is the longest river in Italy

explanation.surface: Animals locate fruit near a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Hippopotamuses are large African river mammals.

clue.text: It doesn't hurt when father's away from home more

definitions.text: when father's away from home more
definitions.meaning: a cryptic reading: if dad is away more

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is a cryptic reading: father (PA) at home (IN) less, which is the same as being away more.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that causes no suffering is free of hurt; dad being home less often is a playful split of the word.

clue.text: Back-slapping sailors?

parts.note: sailors are traditionally addressed as 'me ...', and hearty people are back-slapping and jovial

explanation.definitionFit: Jolly seamen are traditionally called 'me hearties', and hearty means boisterously friendly.

clue.text: VIPs give it a going-over

parts.note: a going-over sounds like a beating, but celebrities literally walk over this carpet laid out for them

explanation.definitionFit: Celebrities at a premiere walk along a ceremonial crimson rug laid out for them.

clue.text: The English way? Ah, no — but a foreign sort

definitions.text: The English way? Ah, no — but a foreign sort

indicators.note: a foreign sort of the words suggests their letters sorted into an unfamiliar order

explanation.surface: Is this the English road? No, a road of a foreign type.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foreign sort' rearranges AH NO BUT A, and the whole clue describes a German motorway.
explanation.definitionFit: An autobahn is a German motorway, a foreign kind of highway.

clue.text: Tries to make a little yarn go a long way?

definitions.text: Tries to make a little yarn go a long way?

parts.words: Tries to make a little yarn go a long way?
parts.note: yarn means a story as well as thread; both can be drawn out at length

explanation.definitionFit: To prolong something is to stretch it, as one draws out thread or a story.

clue.text: Cold region of south Spain and Portugal

parts.note: Iberia is the peninsula containing Spain and Portugal

explanation.surface: A chilly area in the south of the Iberian peninsula.
explanation.definitionFit: Siberia is the vast frozen region of northern Asia.

clue.text: Barber's work is to be performed slowly

definitions.meaning: a musical tempo marking meaning at a leisurely pace

explanation.definitionFit: Barber's most famous piece is his string adagio, and the Italian marking directs a leisurely tempo.

clue.text: Exercise supervision in place of a bishop

definitions.meaning: a cryptic reading: in charge of a diocese is OVER a SEE

explanation.walkthrough: A bishop's seat or diocese is his see; being over one splits the word as OVER SEE.
explanation.definitionFit: To supervise is to manage; a bishop's diocese is his see, so being in charge there is a playful split.

clue.text: Buttons said to represent danger to sailors

indicators.note: said signals that the word is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: Buttons is the name for a hotel page boy, from the buttons on his uniform

explanation.surface: Spoken buttons are a warning for those at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: Buttons is the stock name for a uniformed hotel page, as in the Cinderella pantomime.
explanation.definitionFit: A floating warning marker with a bell signals hazards such as rocks to shipping.

clue.text: ABC is different in computer language

indicators.note: different shows the letters are made into something else

explanation.surface: The alphabet is not the same in programming code.
explanation.definitionFit: An early beginner-friendly programming tongue is named with this acronym.

clue.text: Vessel for a service in church

indicators.note: in shows the pieces placed within the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
the RAF, the Royal Air Force, is one of the armed services

explanation.surface: A container used during a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: A carafe is a glass container for wine or water.

clue.text: Actor's instruction to play "as you like it"?

definitions.text: Actor's instruction to play "as you like it"?

parts.words: Actor's instruction to play "as you like it"?
parts.note: a direction to improvise freely, not to stage the Shakespeare comedy

explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means at pleasure, so an actor told this improvises.

clue.text: Right to put junction on road in France

parts.note: a T-junction gives T
rue is French for street

explanation.surface: Permission to build a junction on a French road.
explanation.definitionFit: True can mean correct, as does right.

clue.text: Stands up for more money

explanation.definitionFit: Getting up from a seat and salary increases both share this word.

clue.text: A harvest on new soil in ancient Greece

parts.note: a crop is a harvest

indicators.note: new signals the letters of soil in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A harvest grown on fresh soil in the classical age.
explanation.definitionFit: The citadel of Athens is the most famous landmark of the classical Hellenic world.

clue.text: Car not fixed?

parts.note: a vehicle whose roof is not permanent but can be folded back

explanation.definitionFit: A drop-top vehicle has a roof that can be lowered, so its shape can change.
